headline: KLA Corporation Has Had a Rough Month: A Wall Street Pro Sees 70% Upside Because of It
summary: KLA Corporation just delivered a clean earnings beat and bullish forward guidance, yet the stock plunged double digits anyway. One top Wall Street analyst sees that panic as the setup of the year in semiconductor equipment.
